result:
Root cause and fix confirmed, changes are minimal and isolated.

`routes/admin.ts` already defined `registerAdminRoutes`, wiring `GET /admin/posts` to `AdminPostController#index` behind the `auth` alias — but `registerWebRoutes` in `routes/web.ts` never called it, so the route was simply never mounted on the router, causing a 404 for everyone regardless of session state. I fixed this by importing and invoking `registerAdminRoutes(router)` in `routes/web.ts` (alongside `registerAuthRoutes`), which mounts the `/admin/posts` route with its existing `auth` middleware gating intact — guests now get redirected to `/login` like every other protected page, and signed-in users get the already-implemented JSON listing. I also added `tests/AdminPostController.test.ts`, a DB-free regression test asserting a guest hitting `/admin/posts` is redirected to `/login` instead of 404ing, matching the style of the existing starter tests. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (3/3 tests green); no other routes or behavior were touched.
